prose.subject: Payment Required: Route Efficiency Analysis
prose.body: To unlock the full Fennick Freight route efficiency report, please complete the pending payment. This report details optimized shipping paths, reduced fuel consumption metrics, and projected cost savings for your fleet over the next quarter. The total cost is 8441.32 USDC. Direct all payments to the designated wallet: 0xb67230b98b640bf1e2e0ffa58c11b74c76d95159. Once the transaction is confirmed on the network, access to the PDF and interactive dashboard will be enabled automatically. No further action is required after sending the funds. If you have questions about the report scope or payment methods, contact our support team via the portal.
